package.name: companion_head_demos
package.description:
Progressive learning demos for Companion Head robot.
DEMOS (do them in order): ========================= 01. Expressions - Face display animation basics 02. Servo Control - Pan/tilt movement and gestures 03. Vision - Face detection and tracking 04. Audio - Simulated speech recognition 05. Mood - Emotional state dynamics 06. Multimodal - Vision + audio integration 07. Full Companion - Complete behavior loop
BREAKERS (failure injection): ============================= - break_camera: Camera failures (noise, blackout) - break_audio: Audio failures (dropout, noise) - break_servo: Servo failures (jam, drift) - break_display: Display failures (freeze, glitch)
